[RARC.5.5.3] This is an architectural invariant: every time value the engine
computes with — `now()`, fact timestamps, TTL and timer deadlines, the clock
tick — must come from the clock source. A subsystem that read host time
directly would diverge on replay and break the determinism guarantee. The
one other reading of host time is a real-time tier's pump-WCET measurement,
which no rule reads and which decides only the halt of [RTCT.7.3].
